title: zk-fluence
tagline: Web3 Establishes the trust layer for Web3 creators using zero-knowledge
description:
zkFluence is a Farcaster Mini App that lets brands run creator campaigns with verified creators, automated content audits, and instant Celo rewards.

Creators authenticate with:

Self.xyz: ZK Proof of Humanity, OFAC cleared, 18+ verification

ZK TikTok ownership: cryptographic proof that they own their account

Then we compute their Creator Validation Score, or CVS a reputation score based on interaction quality, content completion history, compliance integrity, consistency, and fraud penalties.

Creators browse campaigns directly inside Farcaster, submit TikTok links, and our engine automatically audits the content:
keywords, transcript, duration, and signals of fake engagement.

Reviewers only see clean, pre-audited submissions removing the chance for collusion.

Rewards are sent instantly through Celo.
how_its_made:
zkFluence is a full Farcaster Mini App built on top of Next.js 15 + Frame SDK, integrated with Self.xyz, Celo, and a custom TikTok data pipeline.

We use Self.xyz for ZK identity proofs (Proof-of-Humanity, OFAC-clear, region + age verification). This lets us validate creators without ever seeing personal data. We also built a ZK TikTok ownership check that combines OAuth tokens with a cryptographic challenge to prove the creator actually owns their TikTok account, without exposing identity.

Content validation runs through our own TikTok scraper + ML-lite engine, which extracts transcripts, verifies keywords, checks duration, and detects bot-like interaction patterns. Before any human reviewer touches a submission, we run a full automated audit to prevent reviewer-creator collusion.

On-chain, we built Celo smart contracts for reward escrow, instant stablecoin payouts
